subtitle.purpose: Row and card titles, dialog and state h3. 1.0625rem/1.3 Aptos 700.

meta.purpose: Timestamps, helpers, table headers, tooltips, small. 0.8125rem/1.35 400/600.

caption.purpose: The 12px floor: count badge and kept eyebrows (uppercase, 0.12em).

data-md.purpose: Period range on phones, legend %, card figures. 1.125rem/1.2 700, tabular.

shadows.name: ambient-panel
shadows.purpose: Top-level heroes, panels and the notifications popover only; nested surfaces are flat.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The keyboard focus indicator (--focus-ring): a deep-blue outline (>= 8:1 on white and morning mist) on every :focus-visible; buttons add the cyan halo (--focus-halo) outside it. Alpha-only cyan/blue rings are retired (< 3:1).

shadows.name: focus-field
shadows.purpose: Fields on focus: deep-blue border thickened to 2px plus the cyan halo; a transparent outline keeps a ring in forced-colors mode.

motion.name: control-ease
motion.purpose: Lift, shadow and border transitions on controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion becomes instant (no translate, slide, chart animation, smooth scroll); state changes remain.

pending.purpose: Analysis not yet run; link requests awaiting a decision. Neutral, never amber.

atypical.purpose: Atypical day; one chip style on every surface.

selected.purpose: Selected day pill, table row, mobile card and active segmented chip.

blue.purpose: Hovers, washes, chart grid (12), scrollbars (32); selection bg (10) and border (55).

cyan.purpose: Info washes and soft focus/hover halos.

chartTimeAxis.gapMarker: dotted muted reference line labelled 'lacuna' plus a one-line note

weeklyAggregation.scope: chart only; day strip and tables stay daily

chartTimeAxis.dayStrip: opens scrolled (strip only) to the selected or most recent day

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action of a region; gradient pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 700 0.875rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #126fc1, #0d7f55); box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(20, 99, 155, 0.18); cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(16, 59, 97, 0.14); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a4c9c; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(39, 183, 231, 0.2); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; font: 700 0.875rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #0a4c9c; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); border: 1px solid rgba(19, 100, 174, 0.3); box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(22, 76, 126, 0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(16, 59, 97, 0.14); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a4c9c; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(39, 183, 231, 0.22); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action, always behind a confirmation dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; font: 700 0.875rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #b23a50; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); border: 1px solid rgba(227, 93, 115, 0.35); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover, .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a4c9c; outline-offset: 2px; background: rgba(227, 93, 115, 0.08); border-color: rgba(227, 93, 115, 0.55); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled field with soft pill-ish shell.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #56677e; } .ds-field input { min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(22, 124, 217, 0.14); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); color: #17304a; font: inherit; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 2px solid transparent; border-color: #0a4c9c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #0a4c9c, 0 0 0 5px rgba(39, 183, 231, 0.18); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Topbar pill links; active takes the gradient.
components.html: Visão geralQuestionamentos 3
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 12px 20px; font-size: 0.875rem; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; color: #56677e; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #0a4c9c; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a4c9c; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(39, 183, 231, 0.22); } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #126fc1, #0d7f55); } .ds-count { min-width: 1.45rem; min-height: 1.45rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; background: rgba(39, 183, 231, 0.14); color: #0a4c9c; }

components.name: Status Badges
components.description: Tinted pills naming a state; pending is neutral and dashed, atypical is amber.
components.html: Estável Aguardando análise Atípico Manual
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 1.75rem; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 700 0.875rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-badge--green { background: rgba(30, 171, 105, 0.12); color: #0b7a51; } .ds-badge--pending { background: rgba(82, 100, 122, 0.10); color: #52647a; border: 1px dashed rgba(82, 100, 122, 0.4); } .ds-badge--atypical { background: rgba(244, 169, 61, 0.16); color: #8a5300; } .ds-badge--soft { background: rgba(97, 121, 146, 0.1); color: #52647a; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Base container: heading and description; an eyebrow only when it adds context the heading lacks.
components.html:
Meus médicos

Médicos que podem ver seus dados.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 24px; border-radius: 30px; border: 1px solid rgba(22, 124, 217, 0.14); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94); box-shadow: 0 24px 52px rgba(20, 79, 126, 0.14); color: #17304a; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Bahnschrift SemiBold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-panel p { margin: 4px 0 0; max-width: 60ch; color: #56677e; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Segmented Chip
components.description: Toggles and selection use the blue selection tint, never the gradient.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(22, 124, 217, 0.14); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); color: #0a4c9c; font: 700 0.875rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip.is-active { background: rgba(22, 124, 217, 0.10); border-color: rgba(22, 124, 217, 0.55); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Exclusive view toggle (period / selected day): role=group with aria-pressed buttons inside one hairline pill; the pressed button takes the selection tint, never the gradient. Right-aligned in the panel header on desktop, full width under the heading on phones.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(22, 124, 217, 0.14); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; } .ds-segmented button { flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #56677e; font: 700 0.875rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: rgba(22, 124, 217, 0.10); border-color: rgba(22, 124, 217, 0.55); color: #0a4c9c; }

components.name: Period Bar
components.description: One panel stating the active window: data-md range line, meta lines for the window kind and the available history, ghost actions 'Alterar período' (disclosure with the date form, aria-expanded) and 'Ver todo o histórico'; notices (adjusted period, selected-day chips, pending note) stack inside it.
components.html:
Período: 01/04/1989 – 30/04/1989

Janela padrão de 30 dias.
components.css: .ds-period-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px 24px; padding: 20px 24px; border-radius: 30px; border: 1px solid rgba(22, 124, 217, 0.14); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94); } .ds-period-bar h2 { margin: 0; font: 700 1.125rem/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-period-bar p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #56677e; font-size: 0.8125rem; }

components.name: Disclosure Panel
components.description: On phones a data panel collapses into <details> whose summary carries the h2 with a count ('Evolução diária (30 dias)') and a rotating chevron; closed by default. Its rows are divider rows, not cards.
components.css: .ds-disclosure > summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 2.75rem; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-disclosure > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }

narrative.overview: MyGlico should feel like a trustworthy, welcoming clinic: trust blue for action and structure, steady green for stability, and nothing that alarms. The system pairs a soft form language (pills, generous 20–30 px corners, translucent white panels over a pale morning-mist background) with precise information: legible numbers, explicit states, and chips that name what is going on. The balance is deliberate. The form welcomes patients who are not technical; the information stays as precise as a clinical panel. Warmth comes from shape and space, never from vague data.
keyCharacteristics: Blue→green action gradient (action-blue → action-green, 135°) reserved for the primary action, the active nav link and the current page; darker stops keep white labels above 4.5:1.
Translucent white panels with a hairline blue border and a diffuse ambient shadow; nested surfaces are flat with no shadow.
Pill-shaped controls everywhere (buttons, chips, badges, nav links, pagination).
A condensed geometric display face for headings and key figures over a humanist sans body; 13 type roles, nothing below 12px, tabular numerals.
Headings carry their own weight; an eyebrow appears only when it adds context the heading lacks.

rules.name: The Gradient Means Go Rule
rules.body: The action gradient marks only the main action of a region, the active nav link and the current pagination page. One gradient-filled button per region. Toggles and selection use the blue selection tint.

rules.name: The Calm Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber and rose appear as tints with dark text (amber-attention-text, rose-alert-text), never as large fills, except the confirm button of a destructive dialog.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Earns Its Place Rule
rules.body: A panel opens with its h2 and an optional one-line description. Add an eyebrow (caption role, uppercase, 0.12em) only when it gives context the heading lacks; never one that restates the heading.

rules.name: The No Decoration Rule
rules.body: No gradients or tone tints on cards that carry no state; a flat tint only for a real state (atypical, pending, selected, own message).

rules.name: The Divider Row Rule
rules.body: Lists inside panels (conversations, doctor links, pending requests, prompts, phone patient list) are rows separated by a top hairline with 16px vertical padding; no per-row card. A row that opens something stretches its text link over the row. Ended links collapse behind a 'Vínculos anteriores (n)' disclosure.

rules.name: The Page Header Rule
rules.body: App pages open with a headline-role h1 and at most one body line on the background, outside any panel, with no eyebrow.

rules.name: The Triage Rail Rule
rules.body: Doctor home at >=1080px: patients table in a 2fr main column, a 1fr (min 320px) rail with pending requests then conversations; DOM and focus order is pending, conversations, patients.

rules.name: The Reading Path Rule
rules.body: Patient detail reads in task order: page header (back link, name h1, meta line, primary action), period bar, period summary (key figures + time in range, the only place the three percentages appear), full-width trend with the day strip, extremes chart, data panels, then the patient's manual entry and the doctor's access section. When the window has no analysed day, one state block replaces summary and charts.

rules.name: The Progressive Disclosure Rule
rules.body: Secondary controls open on demand: the period date form behind 'Alterar período' (open by default when the window is custom or days are selected), the manual entry form behind its header toggle (opened by '#new-reading' or the header CTA), optional entry fields behind 'Mais detalhes (opcional)', and phone data tables behind closed disclosures.

rules.name: The Visible Focus Rule
rules.body: Keyboard focus is always a 2px deep-blue outline 2px outside the element (--focus-ring); the cyan halo only reinforces it. Fields turn their border deep blue and 2px thick. Never remove an outline without one of these replacements, and give scrollers room so the ring is never clipped.

rules.name: The Patient Wait Rule
rules.body: The loading veil blocks with inert (never by trapping keys), announces itself once through a permanent status node, times out at 20s and offers Cancel after 8s, returning focus to the trigger. Typing never raises the veil: search-as-you-type is debounced and refreshes inline, keeping the previous rows.

rules.name: The Land On What Is New Rule
rules.body: A conversation opens on its first unread message, marked by a "New messages (n)" divider, or at its end; only the message list scrolls. Notifications say who sent what and where ("From {name}, in “{title}”") while keeping the event type as their label.

rules.name: The Signals Not Labels Rule
rules.body: The doctor's patient list shows independent factual signals ('Hipo frequente': time below 70 >= 10%; 'Hiper predominante': time high >= 65% or average >= 185 mg/dL) that can coexist, and 'Em faixa' only when neither applies. The filter keeps the single API signal_code (hyper wins) and its help explains both.

rules.name: The Range Reference Rule
rules.body: A reading is positioned against 70-180 mg/dL with a factual chip (within / above 180 / below 70) in the glyco chip styles, never with judgement words.

rules.name: The Honest Time Axis Rule
rules.body: Trend axes show the year when the range spans more than a year, break the line over gaps longer than 14 days with a 'lacuna' marker and note, and on phones aggregate periods over 60 days to weekly averages for the chart only, saying so.

rules.name: The Plain Dialog Rule
rules.body: Dialogs use plain language and a factual scope line, keep secondary inputs behind a closed disclosure, make each row label (checkbox + date + short reason) the 44px target with text-button row actions, have one primary footer action, disable resets with nothing to reset, preselect a forced single choice, and share one inset (--dialog-pad) across header, body and actions.

rules.name: The Tokenized Tint Rule
rules.body: White surfaces use --react-surface-solid and blue/cyan alphas use the --tint-blue-* / --tint-cyan-* scales; raw values live only in :root.

dos: Do build every new screen from the panel + h2 + description structure, using the type roles and the 4px spacing scale.
Do use the shared field, button, badge and state primitives instead of inline styles.
Do keep the gradient for one primary action per region, the active nav link and the current page.
Do put destructive actions in the danger style behind a confirmation dialog.
Do show pending status as the neutral dashed chip and atypical status as the amber chip, both with dark text.
Do render lists as divider rows and make the header 'add/new' action primary only while the list is empty.
Do lock the page scroll while a dialog or the drawer is open (useBodyScrollLock) and trap focus with the shared useFocusTrap.
Do pause polling while the tab is hidden and refresh as soon as it returns.
Do tell chart reference lines apart by dash pattern as well as color, and add a one-sentence descriptive summary under charts that carry a finding.
donts: Don't ship browser-default inputs, square corners or flat #005fcc buttons; those were the off-system patterns removed in the 2026-10 layout review.
Don't add an eyebrow that restates its heading.
Don't set text below 12px or invent font sizes outside the roles.
Don't use the gradient for toggles or selection.
Don't fill large areas with amber or rose.
Don't hardcode colors outside the :root tokens; alert text uses --react-rose-text and --react-amber-text.
Don't put white text on the light brand trust-blue/steady-green fills; use the action gradient.
Don't wrap list items in cards or nest boxes inside rows; revoke is a danger text button, not a bordered pill.
Don't smooth a curve across sparse readings or ship an animation that ignores reduced motion.
Don't leave a disabled primary action without saying what is missing.
Don't use alpha-only focus rings or outline: none without a replacement.
Don't block the browser's own keys (reload, address bar, close tab) while loading.
Don't put conversation titles in notification payloads or tab titles.
